messages:
aj: Heads up — noticed a spike where some service-account tokens end up with project_id=null and they get routed to the fallback rateband. Dashboard shows a 3x jump in 'unknown' project usage. Anyone else seeing this?

devon: saw it too around 03:12 UTC. Traces show exchange path returning no project for a subset of third-party-exchange tokens.

sam: can you paste a trace id or a log snippet so I can query it?

aj: trace=tr_0x9f7b2c. Log snippet from auth-proxy: 
```
2026-03-19T03:12:11Z auth-proxy INFO exchange success user=svc-thirdparty token_id=tok_abc project_id=null origin=ext-proxy
```

chloe: ugh — project_id=null flows into rateband routing which maps to org default. That means traffic gets billed to the org fallback and some orgs hit higher ratebands. We should not attribute these to customer orgs.

lee: we need quick telemetry: pct of requests with project_id=null, token count and tokenized tokens by model. Proposed PromQL (rough):
```promql
sum(rate(auth_requests_total{project=""}[5m])) by (model) / sum(rate(auth_requests_total[5m]))
```

devon: better to tag by exchange_type. Also surface the token-counts from BQ for historical billing windows. Example BigQuery: 
```sql
SELECT exchange_type, COUNT(*) AS calls, SUM(tokens) AS tokens
FROM `infra.auth_logs`
WHERE project_id IS NULL AND ts BETWEEN TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()
GROUP BY exchange_type
```

ops-bot: incident-tracker created INC-2026-4233 for orphaned-SA attribution spike

aj: UX/rollout thoughts:
- short term: mark orphaned requests as non-billable in routing so customer billing isn't affected
- mid term: dashboard + alerts for org admins showing orphaned traffic hitting their org fallback
- long term: require exchange to include origin_claim/assertion verification or fallback to 'internal-orphan' non-billable bucket

chloe: agree. We should also add a console toggle to opt-in/opt-out attribution for historical backfill. Patch idea: default new fallback policy -> 'internal-orphan' (non-billable) for 30 days, then re-evaluate.

sam: i'll sketch dashboard tiles: 1) orphaned requests (count/tokens) by exchange_type, 2) top 10 affected orgs, 3) recent trace samples. Will open PR and link here.

devon: i'll own the prometheus metric and BQ query. I'll add label exchange_type and sample the first 1% of traces with project_id=null so we can triage.

aj: action items: sam -> dashboard PR + dashboard URL; devon -> prometheus + BQ + sampling; chloe -> policy PR for routing fallback; lee -> alert playbook (runbooks + play triggers). I'll file a follow-up doc and link console UX work.

chloe: Draft doc (placeholder): https://redwood.infra/docs/sa-orphan-fallback — will update with policy text and examples.

lee: note: watch dedicated capacity bursts — orphaned traffic currently bumps org rateband and has caused autoscale chatter for a couple tenants.

sam: opened PR #8342 with initial dashboard mock (staging only). cc @devon

devon: :thumbsup: will add metrics this afternoon and tag sampling traces.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary policy patch rolled to staging at 2026-03-19T11:00:00Z

aj: thanks everyone — we'll sync tomorrow 10:00 for roll plan.

sam: quick note — when running BQ job, use partitioned table auth_logs$__PARTITION to keep cost low.

chloe: also adding a telemetry label \"attribution_decision\" with values {attributed, fallback_internal, fallback_global} so dashboards can split cause.

lee: adding alert: orphaned_tokens_pct > 1% for 15m -> pager to eng-platform oncall.

aj: filing follow-up doc + checklist after call.

ops-bot: tag: incident INC-2026-4233 updated -> severity: medium
